status: Locked after one already-open development smoke and before scoring the other 18 PhysTwin-19 cases with the directional endpoint method.
claim_boundary: Post-open mechanism development on the previously examined PhysTwin-19 cohort. A positive result may justify a genuinely fresh-object preregistration but cannot establish confirmation, calibration, or state of the art.

development_history.joint_valid_point_fusion_interpretation: Rejected at smoke: only one identity had both source and multiview support at the final prefix frame, so tangent point fusion reproduced the source endpoint.
development_history.directional_endpoint_interpretation: Passed the development smoke on both metrics by retaining multiview tangent updates when source depth was missing.

method.name: three_view_directional_endpoint_priority
method.local_tangent_basis: Initial object point cloud, 16-nearest-neighbor PCA, rank-two tangent projector and orthogonal rank-one normal projector.
method.nonpriority_update: Existing full 3D source-camera RGB-D robust random-walk update, behavior-compatible with the source baseline.
method.priority_source_update: One-dimensional source RGB-D innovation projected onto the fixed local normal.
method.priority_multiview_update: Two-dimensional redundant-view triangulation innovation projected into the fixed local tangent plane, including frames where source depth is unavailable.
method.correlation_boundary: Source and multiview residuals are never accumulated in the same geometric subspace. Each projected innovation enters one robust-mixture likelihood exactly once.
method.graph_variance: Largest eigenvalue of the 3D endpoint covariance, in square metres; no dimensionless confidence accumulation.
method.selection: Released prefix object-cloud Chamfer only on the nested prefix validation interval.
method.physical_backbone: Object-disjoint MatPhys spring-family replay selected before this observation experiment.

information_boundary.manual_tracks_role: Evaluation only after candidate predictions and selections are fixed.

evaluation.primary_comparator: CoTracker3 source-camera RGB-D lifting with the identical physical backbone and causal selector.

forbidden: changing the 0.40 availability threshold or 16-neighbor basis after inspecting any remaining future score
changing the directional covariance reduction after inspecting any remaining future score
using future CoTracker3, object-cloud, or manual-track values to form or select a prediction
describing this post-open cohort as independent, confirmatory, calibrated, or state of the art
opening any held-v8 or PokeFlex target artifact
